html: Cardiac rehabilitation is a supervised program of exercise, education and support for people recovering from a heart attack, heart surgery or other heart conditions.

image.caption: Programs usually run several weeks, a few sessions a week.
image.title: Illustration of a stethoscope

html:
• Monitored exercise
  • Education on heart-healthy eating and medicines
  • Support for stress and lifestyle changes
Taking part can improve strength and energy, lower the risk of future heart problems, and help people return to everyday activities with confidence.
Ask your cardiologist or primary care provider for a referral.

title: Cardiac rehabilitation
abstract: How a supervised cardiac rehab program helps people recover after a heart event.
